name: town-negative-munchkin-classes-1800
description: The town negative baseline (borg-zoo#81) with the munchkin start unconditionally on for every class, on classes-1800: borg-rs with no store interaction at all against the same build trading normally. The munchkin counterpart of town-negative-classes-1800 (munchkin off for every class). A calibration floor, not a candidate strategy: no improvement is claimed. Same prespecified endpoint as that experiment. Run one arm per workflow run.
